dataset: ScaDS.AI German Line- and Word-Level Handwriting Dataset
source_text_note: The dataset card says the handwritten lines transcribe German Wikipedia excerpts. Underlying text retains CC BY-SA 4.0; runtime metadata records the matched source URL where available.
privacy: Public/open benchmark subset; no customer/family material. Only line crops and transcription metadata are selected in the ephemeral runner; author demographic fields are excluded.
selection: Deterministic first eligible line per distinct page identifier after sorting by archive-relative image path; maximum 8.
